description: Days, parsed habit names, the habit book, streaks, the store and clock ports, and the Habits use cases, with the scaffold counter removed.

accepted.by: Gary (run by Claude on Gary's instruction)

specs.description: A Day round-trips its count, and pred is the day before.
specs.then: days() is 20000 and pred() equals Day::from_days(19999).

specs.description: Days order by their count, including across what would be a month or year boundary.
specs.then: from_days(-1) < from_days(0) < from_days(365), and from_days(0).pred() equals from_days(-1) with no calendar logic involved.

specs.description: Days whose counts differ by more than 1 are not consecutive.
specs.when: streaks is computed with today = Day::from_days(12)
specs.then: longest is 1 and current is 1, because day 11 is missing and the two days do not form a run.

specs.description: A Day round-trips any count, and pred always subtracts exactly one.
specs.given: any i64 n with n > i64::MIN
specs.then: days() == n, pred().days() == n - 1, pred() < Day::from_days(n), and Day::from_days(n) == Day::from_days(m) exactly when n == m.

specs.description: Parsing trims the raw name, keeps the trimmed spelling, and lowercases the key.
specs.then: it returns Ok, display() is "Read Book" and key() is "read book".

specs.description: Names that differ only in case are equal.
specs.then: they are equal, while their display() values stay "Read" and "rEAD".

specs.description: An empty or whitespace-only name is refused.
specs.then: each returns Err(NameError::Empty).

specs.description: A control character inside the trimmed name is refused.
specs.then: each returns Err(NameError::ControlCharacter).

specs.description: Parsing behaves the same way over every input string.
specs.then: if raw.trim() is empty it returns Err(Empty); otherwise, if raw.trim() contains a char with is_control(), it returns Err(ControlCharacter); otherwise it returns Ok(name) with name.display() == raw.trim() and name.key() == raw.trim().to_lowercase().

specs.description: Name equality is key equality.
specs.given: any two strings a and b that both parse
specs.then: the names are equal exactly when a.trim().to_lowercase() == b.trim().to_lowercase().

specs.description: Adding a new habit and then finding it.
specs.then: it returns true, find("read") returns a habit whose name.display() is "Read" and whose days are empty, and habits() has length 1.

specs.description: Checking, unchecking and removing report what happened.
specs.given: a book holding the habit "Read" with no days
specs.when: check(Read, d5), check(Read, d5), uncheck(Read, d5), uncheck(Read, d5) and remove(Read) are called in turn
specs.then: they return Some(true), Some(false), Some(true), Some(false) and true, and afterwards find(Read) is None.

specs.description: habits() returns the habits in key order, regardless of insertion order or case.
specs.when: "walk", "Apple" and "banana" are added in that order
specs.then: habits() lists the displays "Apple", "banana" and "walk".

specs.description: from_entries collapses repeated days within one entry.
specs.then: it returns Ok, and find(Read).days is exactly {d1, d3}.

specs.description: Adding a habit whose key already exists is refused, and the existing habit is left unchanged.
specs.given: a book holding "Read" with the day d1 recorded
specs.then: it returns false, the book still has one habit, its display is "Read" and its days are {d1}.

specs.description: Operations on an absent habit return None or false and leave the book unchanged.
specs.when: check(Walk, d1), uncheck(Walk, d1), find(Walk) and remove(Walk) are called
specs.then: they return None, None, None and false, and the book equals its prior value.

specs.description: from_entries refuses two entries with the same key and names both spellings.
specs.then: it returns Err(DuplicateName { first: "Read", second: "read" }).

specs.description: The book holds at most one habit per key, and each day at most once, under any sequence of operations.
specs.given: any sequence of add, check, uncheck and remove calls over arbitrary names and days
specs.when: the book's habits() are inspected after each call
specs.then: no two habits share a key, habits() is sorted strictly by key, and check(n, d) returns Some(true) only when d was not in find(n).days just before the call.

specs.description: Current and longest streaks when today is recorded.
specs.then: it returns Streaks { current: 2, longest: 3, checked_today: true }.

specs.description: The grace rule keeps yesterday's run alive.
specs.then: it returns Streaks { current: 3, longest: 3, checked_today: false }.

specs.description: No days give all zeros.
specs.given: an empty set of days and today = 100
specs.then: it returns Streaks { current: 0, longest: 0, checked_today: false }.

specs.description: A run that ended two or more days ago is not current.
specs.then: current is 0, longest is 3 and checked_today is false.

specs.description: Days after today count toward none of the three values.
specs.then: it returns Streaks { current: 1, longest: 1, checked_today: true }.

specs.description: streaks matches the rule for any days and any today.
specs.given: any set of days and any today, with past = the days that are <= today
specs.then: checked_today == past.contains(today); longest is the length of the longest run of consecutive counts in past, or 0 when past is empty; current is the length of the run in past ending at today when today is in past, else the run ending at today.pred() when that day is in past, else 0; current <= longest; and the result equals streaks(past, today).

specs.description: In-memory doubles satisfy the ports through &self, using only types imported from the ports module.
specs.given: a test that imports only crate::ports and defines a store wrapping a RefCell<Option<HabitBook>>, plus a fixed clock
specs.when: save(&book) and then load() are called through &dyn HabitStore, and today() through &dyn Clock
specs.then: load returns the saved book, and today returns the fixed Day; Day, HabitName, NameError, Habit, HabitBook, DuplicateName and Streaks all resolve through crate::ports.

specs.description: Each StoreError variant displays as a non-empty line.
specs.given: StoreError::NotFound, Malformed("bad json"), UnknownVersion(7) and Io("denied")
specs.then: each string is non-empty, Malformed contains "bad json", UnknownVersion contains "7" and Io contains "denied".

specs.description: A Display string never spans more than one line, even when its payload holds a newline.
specs.then: neither output contains '\n' or '\r'.

specs.description: Every StoreError displays as exactly one line.
specs.given: any StoreError: NotFound, Malformed(s) or Io(s) for any string s, or UnknownVersion(v) for any u64 v
specs.then: the output is non-empty and contains no '\n' or '\r'.

specs.description: add on a missing store creates the habit and saves once.
specs.given: a store whose load returns Err(NotFound) and a fixed clock
specs.then: it returns Added { created: true }, save is called exactly once, and the saved book holds just "Read" with no days.

specs.description: check with no day records today.
specs.given: a store holding "Read" with no days and a clock at day 50
specs.then: it returns Recorded(day 50), save is called once, and the saved book has days {50} for Read.

specs.description: Repeated check and uncheck report the outcome, and a call that changes nothing saves nothing.
specs.given: a store holding "Read" with the days {49} and a clock at day 50
specs.when: check("Read", Some(49)) and then uncheck("Read", Some(48)) are called
specs.then: they return AlreadyRecorded(49) and NotRecorded(48), and save is never called.

specs.description: status reports every habit in key order, or the one named, without saving.
specs.given: a store holding "walk" with days {49, 50} and "Apple" with days {10}, and a clock at day 50
specs.when: status(None) and then status(Some("WALK")) are called
specs.then: the first returns [Apple { current: 0, longest: 1, checked_today: false }, walk { current: 2, longest: 2, checked_today: true }], the second returns only the walk entry, and save is never called.

specs.description: remove deletes the habit and saves once.
specs.then: it returns RemovedHabit, save is called once, and the saved book holds only Walk.

specs.description: A future day is refused and nothing is saved.
specs.given: a store holding "Read" and a clock at day 50
specs.then: it returns Err(FutureDate { day: 51, today: 50 }) and save is never called.

specs.description: Naming an absent habit returns UnknownHabit with the known names in key order.
specs.when: check("Run", None), uncheck("Run", d1), remove("Run") and status(Some("Run")) are called
specs.then: each returns Err(UnknownHabit { name: "Run", known: ["Apple", "walk"] }) and save is never called.

specs.description: A missing store makes every method other than add report UnknownHabit for a named habit.
specs.given: a store whose load returns Err(NotFound)
specs.then: it returns Err(UnknownHabit { name: "Read", known: [] }) and save is never called; status(None) returns an empty Vec.

specs.description: Invalid names, duplicate adds and store failures are refused without saving.
specs.given: a store holding "Read", and a second store whose load returns Err(Io("denied"))
specs.when: add("  ") and add("READ") are called on the first store, and add("Walk") on the second
specs.then: they return Err(InvalidName(Empty)), AlreadyExists and Err(Store(Io("denied"))) respectively, and save is never called.

specs.description: A save failure is returned as a Store error.
specs.given: a store holding "Read" whose save returns Err(Io("full"))
specs.then: it returns Err(Store(Io("full"))).

specs.description: Over every call, load happens first and save happens at most once, and only when the book changed.
specs.given: any starting book, any clock day, and any use-case call with arbitrary arguments, against a recording store
specs.then: load was the first store call; save was called at most once; and save was called exactly when the result is Ok and the book after the call differs from the loaded book (Added{created:true}, Recorded, Removed or RemovedHabit).

specs.description: The crate builds and its tests run without the counter.
specs.then: it compiles and runs the habit tests, the file tests/counter.rs does not exist, and src/lib.rs declares the domain, ports and usecases modules.

specs.description: No counter item remains, and the composition root names no adapter.
specs.given: the source tree under src/, and tests/counter.rs if it exists (no other file under tests/ is searched: a test file may name what it checks for)
specs.when: it is searched for the identifiers Count, CounterStore, CountValue, InMemoryCounterStore, increment, counter( and increment_once
specs.then: none is found, and the domain, ports and usecases modules name no adapter type
